summary: Full end-to-end verification of BioCore Studio (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest cases pass. Every listed frontend flow works: default page loads with calibrated honeycomb metrics (126.2 / 1120 / 0.0069 / 173.0), all 4 patterns switch in the 3D viewer and update metric cards, all three sliders (cell, wall, hemp) update metrics live via the 180ms debounced /api/predict, AI Agent tab with Radix Select works and returns a real LLM (Anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations, source='ai') recommendation with a coherent domain-specific rationale, Apply-to-Studio propagates params/metrics/3D model, Save Candidate persists to Mongo and lists it, Delete removes it, and Export STL downloads a valid 1.18 MB ASCII STL. Wireframe and Reset View controls also work. No JS console errors (only a benign THREE.Clock deprecation warning).
ai_feature_verdicts: GET /api/patterns - pass - evidence: 200 OK, all 4 keys present, ranges match [5,20]/[0.3,2]/[0,8] (curl + pytest TestPatterns) - skill: n/a
POST /api/predict honeycomb baseline - pass - evidence: G=126.21 MPa, f=1119.8 Hz, zeta=0.0069, rho=172.98 kg/m^3 within calibrated tolerance (pytest test_honeycomb_baseline_calibration) - skill: n/a
POST /api/predict pattern ordering - pass - evidence: gyroid highest G (181.4), spiderweb highest zeta (0.0207) at cell=10/wall=0.5/hemp=0 (pytest + UI probe) - skill: n/a

POST /api/recommend (primary AI feature) - pass - evidence: real LLM response source='ai', on-topic rationale 'Spiderweb pattern maximizes damping via its hierarchical strand geometry... aerospace floor panel vibration attenuation', pattern=spiderweb, cell=18, wall=0.5, hemp=8, damping_ratio=0.06516 (curl POST /api/recommend + UI ai-result render) - skill: ai-testing-llm

Frontend AI flow - pass - evidence: ask-ai-btn -> ai-result rendered a real rationale (>350 chars, on-topic), apply-recommendation-btn set metric-shear=5.4, metric-damping=0.0737 (viewport screenshot) - skill: ai-testing-llm

Candidate CRUD (Mongo) - pass - evidence: POST returns id, GET lists it, DELETE returns {deleted:<id>}, second DELETE 404 (pytest TestCandidates); UI save/delete visible in candidate-list - skill: n/a
STL export - pass - evidence: Playwright expect_download captured spiderweb_core.stl of 1,182,790 bytes - skill: n/a
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Viewer3D.jsx logs 'THREE.Clock deprecated' warning from @react-three/drei internals — cosmetic only, upstream issue.
surrogate.baselines() re-computes on every /api/predict call; cheap but could be cached at module load for micro-optimisation.
CORS is currently '*'; acceptable for single-session demo but should be tightened before any auth is added.
No rate limiting on /api/recommend (LLM cost exposure). Fine for MVP; flag for production.
seed_data_creation: Test candidate created and cleaned up within pytest (TEST_ prefix). UI save/delete round-trip also cleans up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend calibration tolerances are tight (<1 MPa on G, <10 Hz on f). If surrogate coefficients ever change, update TestPredict::test_honeycomb_baseline_calibration accordingly. AI recommend can take 5-30s; pytest uses 90s timeout. Radix Select options are portalled — use data-testid on SelectItem (pattern-opt-*) or role=option name=... for the objective selector.
